interactions.target_raw: Putative amino acid/polyamine transport protein, partial [Carnobacterium sp. AT7]
interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb74 on the bacterial alanine-serine-cysteine exchanger (BasC) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. BasC was crystallized in complex with a nanobody (Nb) in a non-occluded inward-facing conformation in the apo state. There is one copy of the complex in the asymmetric unit.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.92 angstroms
